# CalEye LLM Context

## Identity
CalEye is a Calorie Counter app, AI calorie tracker, and Nutrition tracker for food photo scanning, calorie estimates, macro tracking, meal history, and daily nutrition goals.

Canonical website: https://caleye.co/

Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.caleye.caloriescounter

iOS app: coming soon.

## Short Description
CalEye is a free Calorie Counter app, AI calorie tracker, and Nutrition tracker that scans meal photos, identifies foods, estimates calories and macros, and helps users track daily nutrition without manually searching for every ingredient.

## What CalEye Does
- Scans food photos with AI.
- Identifies food items in meals.
- Estimates calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat, fiber, and other nutrition details.
- Helps users set and follow daily calorie, macro, and nutrition goals.
- Saves meal history with photos, timestamps, and nutrition data.
- Works offline for core tracking features.
- Syncs data when the user reconnects.

## Main Use Cases
- Counting calories from food photos.
- Tracking macros for fitness goals.
- Logging home-cooked meals.
- Logging restaurant meals.
- Reviewing meal history.
- Tracking weight loss nutrition habits.
- Reducing manual food diary entry.

## Target Keywords
- Calorie Counter app
- AI calorie tracker
- Nutrition tracker
- AI calorie counter
- food calorie scanner
- photo calorie counter
- calorie tracking app
- nutrition tracker app
- macro tracker
- AI food scanner

## Feature Summary
### AI Calorie Tracker
CalEye lets users point the camera at a meal and take a photo. The app uses AI to identify food items and prepare a calorie and macro estimate.

### Nutrition Tracker Breakdown
CalEye shows calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat, fiber, and other nutrition details in an easy-to-read format.

### Meal History
CalEye saves logged meals with timestamps, photos, and nutrition data so users can review eating patterns over time.

### Daily Goal Tracking
Users can set daily calorie and macro targets. CalEye tracks progress during the day and helps users stay aligned with their goals.

### Privacy
CalEye is privacy-focused. Food photos are not permanently stored on servers, and AI processing is described as ephemeral.

### Offline Access
CalEye supports core tracking features offline and syncs data when connectivity returns.

## How CalEye Works
1. Open the CalEye calorie counter app.
2. Take a photo of a meal.
3. CalEye identifies food items with AI.
4. CalEye estimates serving sizes, calories, macros, and nutrition details.
5. The user reviews and edits the result if needed.
6. The meal is logged to the user's daily nutrition diary.
7. Daily totals and progress update automatically.

## FAQ
### What is CalEye?
CalEye is a Calorie Counter app, AI calorie tracker, and Nutrition tracker that helps users count calories and track nutrition from food photos.

### Is CalEye free?
CalEye is free to download and use. The free tier includes 10 AI scans per day, meal history, goal tracking, and offline features.

### Does CalEye work on Android?
Yes. CalEye is available on Google Play at https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.caleye.caloriescounter.

### Is CalEye available on iOS?
The iOS version is coming soon.

### Can CalEye count calories from a photo?
Yes. CalEye scans a food photo, identifies foods, estimates portions, and calculates calorie and macro information.

### Is CalEye an AI calorie tracker?
Yes. CalEye uses AI food recognition to help estimate calories, macros, serving sizes, and daily nutrition progress from meal photos.

### Is CalEye a nutrition tracker?
Yes. CalEye tracks nutrition details including calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat, fiber, goals, and meal history.

### Does CalEye support home-cooked meals?
Yes. CalEye is designed to work with home-cooked meals, restaurant dishes, take-out containers, mixed dishes, and packaged foods.

### Does CalEye work offline?
Yes. Core features work offline. Data syncs when the user reconnects.

### What makes CalEye different from a manual food diary?
CalEye reduces manual search and typing by using AI food recognition from meal photos.
